quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on his rookie teammate's early impact in Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: him getting his first points in Philly and then yesterday hitting a big-time three
quotes.quote: It's pretty cool. My rookie mate, it's the first for everything, but him getting his first points in Philly and then yesterday hitting a big-time three, playing some key defensive possessions and then getting a big-time dunk too, so that was pretty cool.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries is impressed by his rookie teammate's early contributions, noting his ability to hit big shots and provide key defensive stops in recent games.

quotes.speaker: Brayden Burries
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries on defensive rebounding and transition defense
quotes.excerpt: stop some from getting transition points and easy points
quotes.quote: Defense, mainly just got to get the ball. Hold them to one shot, you know, less opportunities. Defense, rebound, I feel like just going to get it, winning it. Offensive rebound, kind of the same. Try to rebound, you don't get it, now you're guarding them. So, stop some from getting transition points and easy points.
quotes.social_post: Brayden Burries emphasizes the importance of defensive rebounding to limit opponent opportunities and prevent easy transition points.
